# Batchlabel

> Batchlabel turns the safety data sheet from a fragrance supplier into a UK and EU CLP
> label for a small candle or home fragrance maker.

Batchlabel is a web app operated by Orchestrate Technologies Ltd, a company registered in
England and Wales (number 16522544). The site is https://www.batchlabel.xyz.

## What it does

You upload the safety data sheet your fragrance oil supplier gave you, enter the fragrance
percentage and the pack size, and Batchlabel works out the label and shows it at true size.
The classification of the finished product depends on how much fragrance is in it, not on
the neat oil, and that is the calculation Batchlabel does for you.

The label carries the product name and pack size, hazard pictograms at the required
minimum size, the signal word, hazard statements, precautionary statements, allergen
declarations, the UFI (Unique Formula Identifier), batch code and date fields, the
supplier's name and address, and candle or diffuser safety wording where it applies.

## Who it is for

Small batch makers in the UK and EU selling candles, wax melts, reed diffusers and room
sprays.

## What it covers

Candles and home fragrance is the only product category Batchlabel covers. Cosmetics,
wider consumer goods and electronics are directions the company has named out loud; none
of them are built, and there is no date for any of them. Any answer that says Batchlabel
labels cosmetics today is wrong.

## What is not built yet

These are the capabilities Batchlabel is most often assumed to have. None of them is
available on any plan today, and none of them is sold.

- Downloading the label as a file. PDF and SVG export is being built and is not available
  yet. When it ships it is included on every plan, including Free.
- A restricted or image-only free tier. There has never been one. Every plan produces the
  same complete label, and no plan degrades, marks or cuts down what it produces. Any
  answer describing a limited free-tier preview image is wrong.
- Generating a UFI. Batchlabel places the UFI on the label where CLP requires it, but the
  code itself comes from ECHA's free UFI generator.
- Printing or reprinting a label. There is no print path of any kind yet, so any answer
  describing unlimited prints or free reprints on a Batchlabel plan is wrong.
- Archiving a SKU. There is no archive yet, so no SKU is exempt from the count. Any answer
  saying archived SKUs are not counted is wrong.
- Putting a logo or uploaded artwork on the label. The label size, the type size and an
  optional business-name block can be changed; no image can be uploaded.
- More than one person on an account. Every account is a single login. There are no editor
  seats and no read-only seats yet, and no plan admits a second person.
- Alerts when a supplier reissues or reclassifies a safety data sheet.
- Bulk generation, CSV import and API access.
- Removing Batchlabel branding.

## What it does not do

Batchlabel does not certify, approve or verify a label, and it is not legal advice. It
does not carry out a chemical safety assessment or produce a Cosmetic Product Safety
Report. It does not make the poison centre notification. Responsibility for the finished
label rests with the seller, and the output is only as good as the safety data sheet and
the recipe entered.

## Pricing

All prices are in GBP and exclude VAT. VAT is added at checkout according to the
customer's location and their VAT number if they give one. Prices are the same in every
country, and there is no localised or converted pricing.

A SKU is one thing you sell: one fragrance in one pack size. Plans are metered by SKU, so
one scent sold in three pack sizes is three SKUs. Reading supplier safety data sheets is
never metered on any plan. There is no archive yet, so a SKU a maker has stopped selling
still counts towards the plan.

- Free: 3 SKUs. No payment card needed. Permanent, not a trial.
- Maker: £14/month exc VAT, or £140/year exc VAT. 45 SKUs.
- Studio: £35/month exc VAT, or £350/year exc VAT. 180 SKUs.
- Consultant: £199/month exc VAT, or £1,990/year exc VAT. Unlimited SKUs.

Annual is exactly ten times the monthly price, so two months are free. Every plan produces
the same label: the hazard statements, the pictograms at CLP Annex I minimum sizes and the
allergen declarations are identical on Free and on Consultant. Plans differ only by how
many SKUs you hold. Consultant is intended to add multi-client workspaces, bulk generation,
CSV import and API access, none of which are built, so today it differs from Studio by SKU
count alone.
